title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby. However, with busy schedules, many pregnant women struggle to prepare healthy and delicious meals. In this article, we will introduce 5 cook-once recipes that can help pregnant women have nutritious and delicious dinners.

## Recipe 1: Chicken and Vegetable Soup
Chicken and vegetable soup is a simple yet nutritious meal. To make chicken and vegetable soup, you need:
- 1 chicken (about 1.5 kg)
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of fish sauce
- 2 teaspoons of oil
- Fresh herbs, scallions

Instructions:
- Wash the chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces.
- Wash the vegetables, cut into bite-sized pieces.
- Heat oil in a pot, add garlic and sauté until fragrant.
- Add the chicken and cook until it is golden brown.
- Add the vegetables, water, salt, sugar, and fish sauce.
- Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
- Season with salt and pepper to taste, add fresh herbs and scallions.

## Recipe 2: Stir-Fried Meat and Vegetables
Stir-fried meat and vegetables is a nutritious and easy-to-make meal. To make stir-fried meat and vegetables, you need:
- 100g of beef (or pork)
- 100g of shrimp
- 100g of squid
- 1 carrot
- 1 potato
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of fish sauce
- 2 teaspoons of oil
- Fresh herbs, scallions

Instructions:
- Wash the meat, shrimp, and squid, cut into bite-sized pieces.
- Wash the vegetables, cut into bite-sized pieces.
- Heat oil in a pan, add garlic and sauté until fragrant.
- Add the meat, shrimp, and squid, cook until they are golden brown.
- Add the vegetables, water, salt, sugar, and fish sauce.
- Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
- Season with salt and pepper to taste, add fresh herbs and scallions.

## Recipe 3: Fried Eggs with Vegetables
Fried eggs with vegetables is a simple yet nutritious meal. To make fried eggs with vegetables, you need:
- 2 eggs
- 1 carrot
- 1 potato
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of oil
- Fresh herbs, scallions

Instructions:
- Wash the vegetables, cut into bite-sized pieces.
- Heat oil in a pan, add garlic and sauté until fragrant.
- Add the vegetables, water, salt, and sugar.
- Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
- Crack the eggs into the pan, cook until the eggs are cooked through.
- Season with salt and pepper to taste, add fresh herbs and scallions.

## Recipe 4: Yogurt Parfait with Fruit
Yogurt parfait with fruit is a simple yet nutritious meal. To make yogurt parfait with fruit, you need:
- 1 cup of yogurt
- 1 orange
- 1 banana
- 1 apple
- 1 teaspoon of sugar

Instructions:
- Wash the fruit, cut into bite-sized pieces.
- Mix the yogurt, fruit, and sugar.
- Season with salt and pepper to taste.

## Recipe 5: Fried Rice with Meat and Vegetables
Fried rice with meat and vegetables is a nutritious and easy-to-make meal. To make fried rice with meat and vegetables, you need:
- 2 cups of cooked rice
- 100g of beef (or pork)
- 100g of shrimp
- 100g of squid
- 1 carrot
- 1 potato
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of fish sauce
- 2 teaspoons of oil
- Fresh herbs, scallions

Instructions:
- Wash the meat, shrimp, and squid, cut into bite-sized pieces.
- Wash the vegetables, cut into bite-sized pieces.
- Heat oil in a pan, add garlic and sauté until fragrant.
- Add the meat, shrimp, and squid, cook until they are golden brown.
- Add the vegetables, water, salt, sugar, and fish sauce.
- Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
- Mix the cooked rice into the pan, season with salt and pepper to taste.
- Add fresh herbs and scallions.

## Conclusion
With these 5 cook-once recipes, pregnant women can have nutritious and delicious dinners. To have a healthy pregnancy, women should [learn more about prenatal nutrition](/blog/prenatal-nutrition) and [plan their meals](/planner) accordingly. Additionally, women should [read more about food safety](/blog/food-safety) to ensure their health and the health of their baby.

## Note
Before applying any recipe, pregnant women should consult with their doctor or a nutritionist to ensure that the recipe is safe and suitable for their health condition.

faqs.question: Why is it important to eat a balanced diet during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Eating a balanced diet during pregnancy helps ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby, reduces the risk of complications, and supports the development of the fetus.

faqs.question: How can I ensure food safety during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: To ensure food safety during pregnancy, women should wash their hands and utensils regularly, cook food thoroughly, and avoid eating raw or undercooked meat, poultry, and seafood.

faqs.question: Can I apply these recipes if I have a special dietary need?
faqs.answer: Women with special dietary needs should consult with their doctor or a nutritionist before applying any recipe to ensure that it is safe and suitable for their health condition.
